biomes.name: Contact Marble
biomes.blurb: Spinel, ruby and lapis in white marble (Mogok, Afghanistan). Borders LUSH.

biomes.name: Pegmatite Pocket
biomes.blurb: Elbaite (incl. watermelon), smoky quartz, aquamarine in coarse granite with clay-filled pockets.

biomes.name: Opal Fields
biomes.blurb: Boulder opal seams and kernels in ironstone concretions within weathered sandstone (Queensland).

biomes.name: Oxidized Copper Zone
biomes.blurb: Malachite, azurite, atacamite, brochantite, cuprite, caledonite crusts over tan/rust matrix (Bisbee, Tsumeb).

biomes.name: Franklin
biomes.blurb: Red zincite, black franklinite, green willemite and pink rhodonite in marble (Franklin, NJ). Fluorescent.

biomes.name: Hydrothermal Vug
biomes.blurb: Fluorite cubes, celestine blades/geodes and calcite lining cavities in dolomite (Clay Center, OH).

biomes.name: Sulfur / Hellish
biomes.blurb: Sulfur crystals, realgar and orpiment on red iron-oxide rock (Dallol, Sicily).

biomes.name: Kyanite Schist
biomes.blurb: Giant kyanite blades and almandine garnets in silvery mica schist.

Open-pit Passaic Mine, Sterling Hill (2025): weathered grey-white marble walls of the old open cut — surface-scale host rock around the ore zone (ore not distinguishable here)
